DECLARE @BusinessDate as DATE = '2024-01-04';


SELECT 'DW' DataLayer, Count(CustomerID) CustomerCount FROM DW.DimCustomer
WHERE  @BusinessDate BETWEEN ValidStartDate AND ValidEndDate
--BETWEEN CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8),ValidStartDate,112) AS INT) AND  CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8),ValidEndDate,112) AS INT) 
AND  SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'

UNION ALL

SELECT 'BUSC' DataLayer, COUNT(DISTINCT ORGKEY) CustomerCount FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS

--WHERE CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8),RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE,112) AS INT)  < = @BusinessDate 



DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20240103;


SELECT 'BUSC' DataLayer, ORGKEY FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS
WHERE CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8),RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE,112) AS INT)  < = @BusinessDate 

AND ORGKEY NOT IN (
SELECT CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer
WHERE  @BusinessDate BETWEEN CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8),ValidStartDate,112) AS INT) AND CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8),ValidEndDate,112) AS INT)
--CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(day, -1, CAST(ValidEndDate AS date)) ,112) AS INT)
AND  SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'



SELECT ORGKEY, RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE ORGKEY = 'R01612260'
SELECT * FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerId = 'R01612260'

SELECT COUNT(CustomerID) FROM DW.DimCustomer 
WHERE   CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8),ValidEndDate,112) AS INT) = 20240103
